data.name: Muqaddar
data.gender_notes: Muqaddar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Muqaddar is an Arabic name that signifies the concept of destiny or fate, emphasizing the idea that one's life is predestined by Allah. It is a powerful and meaningful name in Islamic tradition. The name Muqaddar carries the meaning “Destiny or Fate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muqaddar usually hope their child will grow to embody destiny or fate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: As mentioned in the Quran, 'Verily, We have created all things with Qadar (measure, destiny)' (54:49).
data.etymology: Muqaddar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Destiny or Fate.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muqaddar total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_urdu.name: مقدر

in_hindi.name: मुकद्दर
